title: Command of God the Obedience of Faith
description: This sermon delves into the importance of understanding the obedience of faith in relation to our justification. It emphasizes that our obedience is not the basis of our justification, but rather the fruit of genuine faith in Christ. The message highlights the transformative power of justifying faith, which leads to a changed life marked by obedience and conformity to Christ.
